subject: Audit log egress & residency uplift — pricing and credits
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@wellbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@wellbridge.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit log egress + residency uplift pricing question

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo last week. Two follow-ups from our side as we prepare the internal security checklist and procurement ask: 1) We expect to ship ~3 TB/month of audit-log export for analytics (log archive to our S3 in us-east-1). Are there egress or per-GB audit-log export fees we should model? 2) For our EU patient subset we need residency (data-at-rest in eu-west-1) and HSM-backed key wrapping for PHI; curious how you price the residency uplift vs the HSM seat commitment.

High-level numbers: pilot month 1-3: 20k API calls/day, audit logs ~1.2 TB/month; production (post-pilot) 60k calls/day, audit logs ~3 TB/month.

Procurement also asked whether Redwood can offer a short-term credit against the residency uplift if we commit to a 12-month dedicated plan. Putting our SOW drafter on CC — they may send a PO template if we move forward.

Could you share an illustrative pricing split (audit-log egress, residency uplift, HSM seat vs per-usage KMS ops) and any pilot credit options?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khatri
Director, Cloud Security
WellBridge Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log egress + residency uplift pricing question

Samir —

Appreciate the clear numbers — that helps a lot. High level answers below, summarizing typical packaging and what we can propose for WellBridge: 

- Audit log egress: We bill audit log exports at $0.03/GB for standard outbound transfers to customer-owned buckets (lower tiers available at scale). For your pilot volumes (~1.2 TB/mo) that equates to roughly $36/mo; production at 3 TB/mo -> ~$90/mo before discounts. These charges are itemized separately from API token usage.

- Residency uplift (eu-west-1): There is a residency surcharge that covers region-dedicated storage and controls. Typical uplift is 8% of the monthly usage/hosting line for EU residency; for VPC/private deployments we switch to a per-month residency fee (range $2k–$6k depending on guaranteed throughput).

- HSM/KMS options: Two paths — 1) shared-managed KMS (no seat) billed per 10k KMS ops at $0.50/10k ops; 2) HSM-backed dedicated key seats (recommended for HIPAA-sensitive PHI with attestation) charged as an annual seat at $12k/seat/year (includes key management SLA and attestation) plus a small per-op fee.

Pilot credits we can offer: Redwood will provide a 3-month residency uplift credit covering 50% of the residency surcharge (applied as monthly credits) if you sign a 12-month Dedicated commitment within 30 days of pilot completion. We can also offset one-month of audit-log egress for the pilot.

Next steps I propose: Ben (CC) will run a draft numbers table and senior discount conversation; Laura can scope the SOW milestones/acceptance criteria and incorporate the credit language. If you want, send the PO template and we’ll map the line items.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether the EU residency is limited to storage (audit logs) or also includes inference routing (i.e., model serving in eu-west-1)? That materially affects the residency fee path.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Commercial Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log egress + residency uplift pricing question

Samir — looping in Connor from Solutions so we can align on regional serving if needed. A couple of pragmatic options to reduce your up-front burden: 

1) Residency blended credit: For a 12-month dedicated commit (the typical bump we see from customers this size) we can give a 40% credit on the first 3 months of residency uplift, then step down to 10% for months 4-6. That preserves runway for your pilot and aligns to commit.

2) HSM seat concession: We can discount the first HSM seat by 25% if you take a 12-month seat pre-paid. If you prefer per-usage KMS (no seat), we can include a $5k onboarding credit to assist with attestation evidence collection and additional SOC2 delivery.

3) Audit-log egress: open to a volume banding discount once you hit >10 TB/month. Given your projected growth, we can add a 10% egress credit after month 6 if you hit the production numbers.

Pricing guardrails: we want to keep the product lines visible on the invoice (audit logs, residency, HSM/KMS) for your internal cost-allocation team. I’ll prepare a worked example against the numbers Hannah used and a single-line SOW clause that defines credit triggers (pilot completion sign-off + committed ARR).

Connor — can you confirm whether serving in eu-west-1 is required for inference, or just for storage/audit logs? If serving needed, the residency pricing will shift to the dedicated throughput band that Hannah mentioned.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khatri <samir.khatri@wellbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log egress + residency uplift pricing question

Thanks Ben / Hannah — this is helpful and aligns with our expectations. To answer Connor's question (copied here): for the EU patient subset we need both storage residency and inference routing in eu-west-1 (low latency to our EU cluster).

We’re prepared to move forward on a 12-month dedicated commitment contingent on: the residency credit schedule you proposed, the HSM seat discount on the first seat, and the one-month audit log egress offset for the pilot. Procurement will send a PO template by EOD; I’ve attached a preliminary SOW (WellBridge_SOW_Draft_v0.3.pdf) and our SOC2 evidence request list (see RB_SOC2_Attestation_2027.pdf referenced).

Next: please provide a worked pricing example (line items + monthly credit amortization) and a short contract exhibit we can attach to the PO that calls out the credit triggers. I’ll aim to get procurement to issue a signed PO within 7 business days once we have the exhibit.

Regards,
Samir
Samir Khatri
Director, Cloud Security
WellBridge Health
